owner_instruction.verbatim: I can't do api billing for fable. Only subscription. See if you spinup an isolated subagent or something otherwise we need to re-evaluate
owner_instruction.constraint: claude-fable-5 is not reachable for the owner via Anthropic API billing; subscription-billed Claude Code subagents are the only available fable transport

disposition: the blinded reviewer runs as a Claude Code subagent (agent type blinded-reviewer, tools disabled, model claude-fable-5) instead of an Anthropic API call; one fresh subagent per unique payload

amendment_reading.reading: the binding text pins the reviewer model (claude-fable-5) and the isolation properties (fresh context per batch; no repository access, tools, retrieval, conversation memory, or cross-query discussion); it does not pin a billing transport. A per-payload no-tools subagent satisfies every enumerated property at stronger granularity than the per-batch floor. Substituting a different, API-reachable model instead would be the explicitly named protocol deviation (reviewer model change mid-canary).

mechanism.prompt_composition:
frozen content-neutral preamble + '

' + frozen reviewer prompt + '

=== QUERY PAYLOAD ===
' + 'QUERY: <q>
CANDIDATE A: <a>
CANDIDATE B: <b>'; composed mechanically by rejudge/phase2_canary_live.py, per-item sha256 bound into the exported worklist
mechanism.workflow: run_canary(pause_when_unlabeled=True) accumulates unique unlabeled payloads; the driver exports the worklist; each item is labelled by one fresh blinded-reviewer subagent; raw outputs are committed verbatim into the hash-chained decision store (parse failure commits as malformed, non-ALLOW) before any oracle dispatch; the next pass resumes cells from the per-call cache
mechanism.no_live_reviewer: in this mode the in-process reviewer callable refuses if ever consulted; only committed store decisions gate dispatch
mechanism.preamble_verbatim: Do not use any tools. Do not read any files. Answer purely from the text below, and reply with EXACTLY the three lines the instructions specify, nothing else.

agent_runtime.this_session: Claude Code subagent type 'claude', model pinned claude-fable-5; the runtime makes tools available, the frozen preamble forbids their use, and every review's reported usage metadata must show tool_uses: 0 to be committable; a nonzero count is a logged protocol deviation and the decision fails closed as reviewer_error
agent_runtime.successor_sessions: agent definition .claude/agents/blinded-reviewer.md (tools disabled at the runtime level, model fable) is registered but loads only at session start, so it was unavailable to the session that recorded this artifact

disclosed_deviations: the subagent context contains Claude Code harness scaffolding (agent system prompt, environment block including working-directory path and date) that the API design would not have; none of the amendment's enumerated exclusions (checker verdicts, arm identity, clean/placebo mode, judge identity, outcomes, stage results, DEV-350 labels, adjudication notes) appear in that scaffolding
sampling parameters are harness defaults; no frozen artifact pins reviewer decoding parameters (the unbuilt API design had chosen temperature 0)

the orchestrating assistant session transports composed prompts to subagents and raw outputs to the store; mitigations: prompts are mechanically composed and hash-bound, outputs are committed verbatim into the hash-chained store which re-validates parse consistency, and the pre-seeded sentinel audit design is unchanged
contexts are fresh per payload rather than per batch, which is strictly stronger isolation than the per-batch floor
the subagent runtime exposes tools; prevention is by frozen preamble instruction and detection by the runtime's per-review tool_uses metadata, which must equal zero for a decision to commit
adjudication: flagged for the adjudicator (Joey) and the next consult to review post hoc; the estimand language, intercept reporting, and sentinel audit design of the amendment are unchanged
note: Append-only operational disposition under the owner's fixed billing constraint. Grants no new spend authority; canary spend authorization is rejudge/phase2_canary_authorization_2026-07-28.json.
